executor/claudecode/session.go.patch:
diff --git a/executor/claudecode/session.go b/executor/claudecode/session.go
index 1a05f51..0d84b66 100644
--- a/executor/claudecode/session.go
+++ b/executor/claudecode/session.go
@@ -49,6 +49,7 @@ type session struct {
 	failed    bool
 	prevCost  float64
 	costGap   bool
+	modelBase map[string]map[string]float64 // per model, the last successful round's session totals
 	model     string
 
 	closed atomic.Bool

wrong.name: model_round_usage copies the cumulative values
wrong.scenario: A second round reports its own per-model figures
wrong.step: Then exec-round-model-usage-states-its-scope: the second round event says its model_usage is session scoped and reports only the round difference

wrong.name: one baseline for the whole session instead of one per model
wrong.scenario: The first round equals its totals and a model new in a later round starts at zero
wrong.step: Then exec-round-model-usage-states-its-scope: each model is measured against its own baseline and a new model starts at zero

wrong.name: a failed round advances the baseline
wrong.scenario: A failed round does not move the baseline
wrong.step: Then exec-round-model-usage-states-its-scope: the failed round event leaves the baseline where the last successful round put it

executor/claudecode/stream.go.patch:
diff --git a/executor/claudecode/stream.go b/executor/claudecode/stream.go
index f37ab1f..2e829d1 100644
--- a/executor/claudecode/stream.go
+++ b/executor/claudecode/stream.go
@@ -840,7 +840,7 @@ func (r *roundRun) addResult(event map[string]any) {
 		return
 	}
 	addModelUsage(event, res)
-	r.s.addModelRoundUsage(event, res, false)
+	r.s.addModelRoundUsage(event, res, true)
 	r.addDenials(event)
 	_, hasUsage := res["usage"].(map[string]any)
 	_, hasCost := res["total_cost_usd"].(json.Number)

wrong.name: a counter that went down keeps the old baseline
wrong.scenario: A counter that goes down is left out and the lower value becomes the baseline
wrong.step: Then exec-round-model-usage-states-its-scope: a counter that went down is left out and its lower value becomes the baseline

wrong.name: always writes the scope and an empty model_round_usage list
wrong.scenario: Without modelUsage in the result the event has neither new key
wrong.step: Then exec-round-model-usage-states-its-scope: an event without modelUsage has neither new key and a later round measures from zero
